'''Asadatehiko Shrine''' (Asadatehiko-jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, {{ill|Iitani-chō|Q11666679|qid=Q11666679}}.

=== History ===
[[File:Okameiwa rock Asadatehiko jinja.JPG|thumb|Okame Stone at Okame Pond]]
It was formerly called Goō Gongen, but in {{ill|Meiji – year 4|Q11512280|qid=Q11512280}} it was renamed Asadatehiko Shrine. In the {{ill|Awa-shi|Q65291985|qid=Q65291985}}, it is written: “It enshrines Watatsumi Toyotamahiko no Mikoto. Located in Iidani Village, it is commonly called Gongen.” In the “Kanpō Revised Shrine Register,” it is recorded as “Iidani Village Goō Daigongen, bettō Iidani Village Daigo-ji.”

It has been revered as a rain-invoking deity of this region. Within the precincts there is a rock cavity a little over two shaku deep called “Okame Pond,” which never dries up throughout the year, and it is said that rain-prayer rituals were performed there. It is located at an elevation of 700 meters on {{ill|Hiraishi Mountain|Q11483443|qid=Q11483443|lt=Hiraishi Mountain}}, and the surrounding area is designated as {{ill|Higashi Sankei Prefectural Natural Park|Q5753973|qid=Q5753973}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Toyotama-hime|lt=Toyotama-hime|Q2329261|qid=Q2329261|lt=Toyotamabiko no Mikoto}}

=== Access ===
* From in front of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}} {{ill|Tokushima Station|Q860775|qid=Q860775}}, take the {{ill|Tokushima Bus|Q11489648|qid=Q11489648}} Katsura Line and get off at “Nagabashira,” then walk about 60 minutes.
